## Best current rule hypothesis
Find adjacent equal-color diagonal marks (difference of one row and one column; either slope). Continue the same-color line in the direction(s) along that diagonal through background cells, stopping at grid boundary or any non-background obstacle. Preserve seed and obstacle cells. Horizontal/vertical pairs alone do not trigger a continuation. A color may have multiple rays if its marks form multiple qualifying diagonal pairs.

Use explicit 1-based row/column coordinates and enumerate every diagonal equal-color adjacency. Carefully test each possible direction against the background/obstacles.
